critic_risk_flags: Changing the delay from the already-discovered 2 weeks to 1 week is not clearly justified by the provided semantics and increases timing-mismatch risk (early peak) without materially reducing complexity because fractional memory remains. If parsimony is the goal, dropping fractional or simplifying structure is a clearer reduction than shaving 1 week of delay.

I+H is weakly aligned to a hospitalization-rate target and risks absorbing hospitalization signal into I, blurring interpretation and potentially biasing baseline/peak calibration. It also does not resolve the core identifiability issue of H in short series; it adds an additional mixing ambiguity (relative contribution of I vs H) without strong justification.
